assets.label: Figure 16.1
assets.caption: Figure 16.1 The relationship between three measures of marker information: heterozygosity, PIC, and PFIM. Plotted are the maximum values for each measure as a function of the number of marker alleles under the assumption of an even allele-frequency distribution $ (p_i = 1/n) $.

assets.label: Figure 16.2
assets.caption: Figure 16.2 The granddaughter design of Weller et al. (1990). Here, each sire produces a number of half-sib sons that are scored for the marker genotypes. The character value for each son is determined by progeny testing, with the trait value being scored in a large number of daughters (again half-sibs) from each son. More general designs allowing for both full- and half-sib families are examined by van der Beck et al. (1995).

assets.label: Table 16.2
assets.caption: Table 16.2 Sample sizes required to have a 90% chance of detecting a linked QTL using ANOVA with significance level $ \alpha = 0.05 $.

assets.label: Figure 16.3
assets.caption: Figure 16.3 Top: When adjacent marker loci differ in the amount of heterozygosity, interval mapping in an outbred population gives a likelihood map with discontinuities at some of the marker loci (here, at the second marker). Bottom: Likelihood maps that simultaneously use all markers on a chromosome (instead of two at a time, as with interval mapping) have no such discontinuities. This likelihood map considers bovine chromosome U5(10) and examines four milk production traits in the granddaughters of a single sire. Only fat yield (denoted by - - - ) showed a significant LOD score (exceeding the critical value of three), indicating a putative QTL on this chromosome. (After Georges et al. 1995.)

assets.label: Table 16.3
assets.caption: Table 16.3 Probability of various pairs of marker genotypes in relatives as a function of the number of genes ibd between these relatives.

assets.label: Figure 16.4
assets.caption: Figure 16.4 Sample size required to detect a QTL using the $ T_m $ test (Equation 16.50b). Each curve represents a different value for the recombination fraction c between the QTL and linked marker, and plots the number $ n_2 $ of doubly affected sib-pairs required to detect (with 75% power at the 5% significance level) a linked QTL with no dominance variance as a function of $ \lambda_S $ for that QTL. If dominance is present, the required $ n_2 $ are below the plotted values, so these curves serve as upper bounds on the desirable sample size regardless of the amount of dominance. See Appendix 5 for these power calculations.

assets.label: Figure 16.5
assets.caption: Figure 16.5 LOD scores for exclusion mapping, under the assumption of a DS gene with effect $ \lambda_S $ (and no dominance, so $ \lambda_O = \lambda_S $) for a scan of human chromosome 6 for genes influencing diabetes susceptibility (Davies et al. 1994). A LOD score below -2 provides sufficient evidence that a DS gene of specified effect (or greater) is absent from this region. For example, a DS gene with $ \lambda_S \geq 5 $ can be excluded from chromosome positions 70 – 120 cM and 130 – 140 cM. (From Kruglyak and Lander 1995b.)

assets.label: Figure 16.6
assets.caption: Figure 16.6 Information content mapping of a chromosome 6 diabetes scan (Davies et al. 1994) shows those regions where increasing marker density will provide more linkage information (e.g., 70 – 90 cM and 140 – 160 cM). Information content is highest at the markers, falling off in the intervals between markers. (From Kruglyak and Lander 1995b.)

prerequisites.title: Chapter 4 · 遗传图谱构建基础
prerequisites.why_needed: 当前章节利用半同胞家系进行QTL定位，需要理解遗传图谱构建和标记基因的分离原理。
key_points: 遗传连锁标记的类型与信息量
半同胞家系中标记基因型的期望比例
QTL定位的基本统计学原理
prerequisites.concept_title: Chapter 4 · 遗传图谱构建基础
prerequisites.evidence_summary: 当前章节涉及标记基因座和QTL信息性父本，这些概念建立在遗传图谱和连锁分析基础上。

prerequisites.title: 第14章 · 连锁分析与QTL定位基础
prerequisites.why_needed: 第16章的数量性状位点分析依赖于对连锁分析原理、标记杂合性及重组率的理解，这些内容在第14章中已建立。
key_points: 理解连锁分析和遗传图谱构建的基本原理
掌握标记杂合性在亲子代传递中的作用
熟悉重组率计算和最大似然估计方法
prerequisites.concept_title: 第14章 · 连锁分析与QTL定位基础
prerequisites.evidence_summary: 第16章直接使用连锁分析概念（如标记杂合性、最大似然估计），这些是第14章的核心内容。
